senses.gloss: सुसंस्कृत- + उपस्कर सुसंस्कृत- + उपस्कर, i. e. सु-सम्-कृ + त-, f. रा, one who takes great care of the household furniture, Man. 5, 150.
शुष्क- + कलह शुष्क- + कलह, m. a quarrel about trifles, Pañc. 171, 25.
सु-संभ्रान्त सु-संभ्रान्त, adj. greatly bewildered.
सु-स्थित- + मनस् सु-स्थित- + मनस्, adj. content, Hit. ii. d. 5.

सु- + सम्-रब्ध सु- + सम्-रब्ध, adj.
 1. very enraged, Chr. 31, 20. 2. very agitated, Pañc. 238, 24.
सु- + शीतल सु- + शीतल, adj. very cool, Hit. i. d. 96, M.M.

सु- + शील सु- + शील,
 I. adj. 1. well disposed, of good disposition. 2. well made, Pañc. ii. d. 74.
 II. f. ला, the wife of Yama.
शुषिल शुष् + इल, m. Wind.

शुश्रूषक शुश्रूषक, i. e. शुश्रूष, [] desider. of श्रु, + अक,
 I. adj. Obedient, Lass. 41, 14.
 II. m. A servant.
शुश्रूषण शुश्रूषण, i. e. चुश्रूष, see the last, + अन, n. Obedience, MBh. 1, 741.

शुश्रूषा शुश्रूषा, i. e. शुश्रूष, see the last, + अ, f.
 1. Wishing to hear.
 2. Obedience, Lass. 41, 7.
 3. Service, Man. 1, 91; 2, 112; Pañc. 214, 19; reverence, Man. 2, 229.
 4. Speaking.
 --Comp.
शुश्रूषु शुश्रूषु, i. e. शुश्रूष, see the last, + उ, adj. Obedient, attentive, Man. 2, 109; MBh. 1, 740.

शुष् शुष् (for सुष्, and that for original सुस्; श् for स्, by the assimilating influence of ष्), i. 4, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., Rām. 2, 96, 34),
 1. To become dry, literally and figuratively, Rām. 2, 69, 19; MBh. 2, 1685; 3, 591.
 2. To be withered, to be afflicted, Draup. 6, 11.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. शुष्क.
 1. Dried up, Pañc. 51, 5; dry, Pañc. ii. d. 96.
 2. Causeless, Pañc. 172, 1.
 3. Unprofitable.
 4. Offensive, Man. 11, 35.
 --Caus.
 1. To dry up, Pañc. i. d. 117; MBh. 3, 189.
 2. To emaciate, Man. 6, 24.
 3. To destroy, Gīt. 12, 5.
 --With the prep. उद् उद्, Caus.
 1. To dry up, Rām. 2, 64, 65.
 2. To emaciate, Chr. 57, 23.
 --With समुद् सम्-उद्, To become dried up, Bhaṭṭ. 16, 17.
 --With उप उप, Caus.
 1. To dry up, MBh. 3, 12874.
 2. To emaciate, MBh. 1, 4624.
 --With परि परि,
 1. To become dried up and withered, Rām. 2, 30, 25.
 2. To be afflicted, Chr. 12, 25. परि-शुष्क, []
 1. Completely dry, Rām. 2, 59, 9.
 2. Withered.
 3. Emaciated, Rām. 4, 16, 35.
 --Caus. To emaciate, Pañc. 182, 11.
 --With वि वि, विशुष्क,
 1. Very dry, thirsty, Ṛt. 1, 15
 2. Withered, Mālat. 78, 4.
 --Caus. To dry up, MBh. 3, 10767.
 --With सम् सम्, To be dried up, MBh. 1, 8230. संशुष्क, Completely dry, Ṛt. 1, 22.
 --Caus. To dry up, Ragh. 6, 36.
 --Cf. σαυσαρός, σαυκός (= शुष्क for सुस् + क), σαυχμός, αὐχμός, σαχνός, αὔω, αὖος, αὐστηρός; Lat. siccus (= शुष्क for सुस् + क); Goth. siuk; A.S. seoc, seac, sioc, sic; O.H.G. siuh, siuchî, siuhjan; Goth. sauht; A.S. and O.H.G. suht.
शूष् शूष्, see सूष्.
† सूष् सूष् (cf. 1. सु), शूष् शूष्, i. 1, Par. To bring forth, to bear.

शुष शुष् + अ, m., and शुषि or षी शुष् + ई̆,
 1. Drying.
 2. A hole in the ground.

शुषिर शुष् + इर,
 I. adj. Perforated (cf. शुष).
 II. m.
 1. Fire.
 2. A rat.
 III. n.
 1. A hole.
 2. A wind instrument.
शुष्क शुष्क, see शुष्.
शुष्कल शुष्क + ल, m., f. ला, and ली, and n. Dry flesh.

शुष्ण शुष्ण, i. e. शुष् + न, m.
 1. The sun.
 2. Fire.

शुष्म शुष् + म,
 I. adj. Strong, Chr. 291, 14 = Rigv. i. 64, 14.
 II. m.
 1. The sun.
 2. Fire.
 3. Wind.
 III. n. Light.
 --Comp.

शुष्मन् शुष् + मन्,
 I. m. Fire.
 II. n.
 1. Light, lustre.
 2. Strength.
शुष्मिन् शुष्मिन्, i. e. शुष्म + इन्, adj. Strong, Hiḍ. 1, 13.
सु- + श्रवस् सु- + श्रवस्, adj. famous, Chr. 288, 2 = Rigv. i. 49, 2 (cf. εὐκλεής).
सु-श्रोणी सु-श्रोणी, adj., f. καλλίπυγος, Lass. 52, 2.
सु- + श्लिष्ट सु- + श्लिष्ट, adj. 1. well fastened, Hit. i. d. 87, M.M. 2. well strung, Mālat. 18, 4.
सु- + संधित सु- + संधित, adj. well reconciled, Pañc. iii. d. 24.
सु- + संबन्ध सु- + संबन्ध, adj. well joined, Pañc. ii. d. 136.
सु- + संभ्रम सु- + संभ्रम, m. great haste, Hit. pr. d. 15, M.M.
सु- + सामन् सु- + सामन्, n. good negotiation, Pañc. iii. 21.
सु- + सार सु- + सार, m. 1. a kind of jewel or crystal (?), MBh. 7, 672. 2. Mimosa catechu.
सुशंस सु-शंस् + अ, adj. Well-praising, a good praiser, Lass. 101, 15 = Rigv. vii. 16, 6.
सुशमी सु-शम् + ई (?), m. A good acquirer (?), Lass. 101, 6 (so to be read instead of सुशर्मा) = Rigv. vii. 16, 2.
सुशीम सुशीम, see सुषीम.

सुशीम सुशीम,
 I. adj.
 1. Cold.
 2. Pleasant.
 3. Intense, Daśak. 106, 6, cf. Wils., n.
 II. m.
 1. Cold.
 2. The moon gem.
 3. A sort of snake.
सुषीम सुषीम, also (better, cf. शीत),
सुषंसद् सुषंसद्, i. e. सु-संसद्, adj. Endowed with a comfortable house, Chr. 296, 7 = Rigv. i. 112, 7.

सुषम सुषम, i. e. सु-सम,
 I. adj.
 1. Same, even.
 2. Beautiful.
 3. All.
 II. f. मा, Exquisite beauty.
सुषि सुषि, सुषिर सुषिर = शुषि, शुषिर.
सुषुप्त सुषुप्त, i. e. सु-सुप्त (vb. स्वप्), adj. Fast asleep.
सुषुप्ति सुषुप्ति, i. e. सु-सुप्ति, f. Deep sleep, insensibility, Vedāntas. in Chr. 204, 22.
सुषुम्णा सुषुम्णा, f. An artery, Bhāg. P. 2, 2, 24 (Sch.).
सुष्टुति सुष्टुति, i. e. सु-स्तुति. f. A [] beautiful hymn, Lass. 99, 5 = Rigv. iii. 62, 7.

सुष्ठु सुष्ठु, i. e. सु-स्था + उ, adv.
 1. Well, Hit. 73, 21; Vikr. 60, 6; excellently.
 2. Much, very much.

सुस्थ सु-स्थ (vb. स्था), adj.
 1. Being well, healthy, Hit. iii. d. 119; Man. 4, 142.
 2. Happy, Utt. Rāmac. 16, 13.
सु- + स्थ सु- + स्थ, adj. 1. living well. 2. being well. 3. safe, Mālat. 86, 12.
सु- + सूक्ष्म सु- + सूक्ष्म, adj. very small, Pañc. ii. d. 42.

सु- + सेवित सु- + सेवित, adj. well served, Hit. i. d. 21, M.M. सेव्य,
 1. To be taken care of.
 2. Venerable; with जन, Master, Vikr. d. 39. m., f. या, and n. Names of plants.
सु- + स्त्री सु- + स्त्री, f. a brave wife, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1155.
सु- + स्थिति सु- + स्थिति, f. 1. welfare. 2. health.

सु- + स्ना सु- + स्ना,
 I. adj. very clean, Lass. 24, 4.
 II. m. a student who has performed his ablutions preparatory or subsequent to a sacrifice.
सु- + स्मित सु- + स्मित, adj. smiling. f. ता, a woman with a smiling countenance.
शुष्क- + स्रोत शुष्क- + स्रोत, adj., [] f. ता, of whom the water is dried up, Nal. 16, 14.
सु- + स्वप्न सु- + स्वप्न, m. a lucky dream.
सु- + स्वर सु- + स्वर, adj. loud, Chr. 12, 28.
